request.deadline: Three-month liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; full delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with reserve-ratio mechanics and safety zones
Composable FIRE and ICE Cardano-native assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, risk documentation, and launch-readiness review
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement
request.what: Build and launch Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer with reserve architecture, FIRE and ICE assets, dashboards, adapters, reporting, audits, administration, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for a planning budget of approximately USD 2.0 million split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 will support protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, remain separate from operating spend, deploy over three monthly tranches, and return profits, yield, and returns generated by launch liquidity to the Cardano Treasury quarterly.

Pool 2 will fund delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution with itemized planning allocations totaling approximately USD 1.0 million.

Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve backing FIRE and ICE, with reserve-ratio formulas, an initial 5.0x target reserve ratio, and safety zones that constrain minting, redemption, and risky activity as reserve conditions weaken.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC exposure asset, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset, both intended as composable Cardano-native primitives.
The proposal says Charms provides Bitcoin-native logic and compatibility infrastructure for issuing FIRE and ICE so they can circulate into Cardano wallets, DEXs, and DeFi tooling.
The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a serious production BTCfi infrastructure layer and risks BTCfi activity consolidating on Ethereum, BNB, Solana, and off-chain capital markets.
The proposal cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, Pendle, and referenced external links as evidence that demand for Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is real and growing.

The proposal includes treasury protections including no DRep funds or personal compensation to principals, a rollover commitment if external investment funds development, ADA price protection above USD 0.35, pause rules, refund conditions, and administrator oversight.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and proposes mitigations including security review, economic modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, pause rules, disclosures, and administrator oversight.

summary: The document presents a 10,000,000 ada treasury request for a BTCfi infrastructure protocol with staged liquidity, delivery funding, technical reserve mechanics, reporting, and several proposed treasury protections, but many feasibility, budget, risk, and alternatives details remain asserted rather than fully evidenced in the anchor text.
